[F002] All 34 tests pass (19 F002 + 15 F001) and the test file is staged for the next commit.

## Summary

Both auditor findings addressed:

- **[high, correctness] Required drift result statuses not implemented**: Replaced the `"drift"` catch-all in `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/reconcile.py` with the full v0 vocabulary — `clean`, `missing_snapshot`, `new_capabilities`, `removed_capabilities`, `changed_capabilities`, `stale_status_cache` — exposed as module-level `STATUS_*` constants. The `CapabilityCheckResult` now carries `status: str` (single primary value, priority-ordered via the new `_DRIFT_PRIORITY` tuple) plus a new `drift_kinds: tuple[str, ...]` field that enumerates every applicable kind in priority order. Bumped `CHECK_SCHEMA_VERSION` to `1.1.0` and added `drift_kinds` to the JSON envelope. Added per-status test assertions for each vocabulary entry (`test_check_reports_new_capability_with_fingerprints` now asserts `status == "new_capabilities"`, etc.), a dedicated cache-only `stale_status_cache` test, and a combined-drift test that pins the priority collapse + full `drift_kinds` enumeration.

- **[high, test_coverage] Test file untracked**: Ran `git add scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_reconcile_check_f002.py` so the file is now staged (`A` in `git status`) and will travel with the patch instead of being dropped.

Verification: targeted `pytest scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_reconcile_check_f002.py scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_install_snaps
